crossRefs.note: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod…
and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

people.name: Gershom
people.line: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
